title: Where I am right now
line: A look at today, without fixing anything
opening: No need to sum anything up. Just notice where you are today.
closing: That's where you are, for now. It doesn't have to be anywhere else.

title: Know myself
opening: Questions about you, from you. There are no wrong answers here, only your own.
closing: You know yourself a little better than you did a few questions ago. That counts.

title: Values and what matters
line: What you care about, when it's quiet
opening: Under the busy days there are a few things you care about. Let's find them.
closing: Those are yours. You can come back to them whenever a choice feels hard.

title: A decision I'm facing
opening: You don't have to decide anything today. Just look at it from a few sides.
closing: Whatever you choose, you thought it through. That's worth something.

title: Relationships
line: The people in your life, and you with them
opening: The people around us shape our days. Let's think about yours.
closing: Relationships keep changing, and so do we. Thank you for looking at yours honestly.

title: Work and purpose
line: What you do, and what it means to you
opening: Work takes up a lot of life. Let's see what it's giving you, and what it's taking.
closing: Purpose doesn't have to be grand. It can be in how you spend an ordinary day.

title: Fears and worries
line: Look at a worry from a safe distance
opening: Worries are often easier to look at when they're written down. Go at your own pace.
closing: You looked at something hard. You can put it down again now.

title: Letting go
line: Something you're ready to set down
opening: Some things are heavy to keep carrying. Let's see which ones.
closing: Letting go is usually slow. Today you took a step.

title: Gratitude and what's working
opening: Hard things tend to get our attention first. Let's give the good things a turn.
closing: Those good things were there all along. Now you've written them down.

title: A month or year in review
line: Look back over a stretch of time
opening: Let's look back over a stretch of time, gently, and see what it held.
closing: That was a stretch of your life. You lived it, and now you've looked at it.

title: Something I'm avoiding
line: A thing you keep putting off
opening: We all put some things off. Let's look at one, without judging it.
closing: Now you know a bit more about why it's been waiting. That often makes the next step easier.

title: Who I want to become
opening: Let's imagine a little ahead: not who you ought to be, just who you'd like to be.
closing: You don't have to get there all at once. Knowing the direction is a start.
